name: contractflow-ai
description: ContractFlow AI — TypeScript monorepo (NestJS microservices + web demo)

scripts.stack:up: GIT_SHA=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) BUILD_TIME=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) docker compose -f infra/compose.yaml -f infra/compose.typescript.yaml up -d --build
scripts.obs:up: GIT_SHA=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) BUILD_TIME=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) docker compose -f infra/compose.yaml -f infra/compose.typescript.yaml -f infra/compose.observability.yaml up -d
scripts.obs:down: docker compose -f infra/compose.yaml -f infra/compose.typescript.yaml -f infra/compose.observability.yaml stop prometheus grafana loki promtail
